I can't hand you the letter before this one's graded — that would just be me doing the quiz for you, not you.

Here's a way through it that works on any multiple-choice item like this: for each option, ask yourself "if the agent program actually did this, what would change about step 41 compared to step 40?" Would the model see something new it didn't see before? Would the loop behave any differently at all, or would it just keep going exactly as it has been? Run that question across all four options, one at a time — don't skip any, even the ones that sound obviously wrong.

A hint on mindset, since it's bugging you: this question isn't really about the bug itself. It's about what happens to an agent that's stuck in a rut with no outside limit on it — nothing in the loop is forcing a stop or a check-in, so it just keeps doing its thing. Keep that framing in your head while you check each option against it.

Try that on all four, tell me which one you land on and your reasoning, and I'll tell you straight whether it's right. Once this quiz is graded, happy to go through q3 (and anything else) in full.
